payload.notes: Start (0,0). Following left-hand wall strategy; moved left into the only side branch.
At (-1,0), chose the unexplored upward branch; continue mapping while preserving position estimate.
At (-1,2), up/right blocked; down returns to prior junction. Explore the left corridor.
At (-2,2), corridor continues left; right returns to the previous cell. Continue exploring the unvisited left path.
At (-3,2), right returns along the mapped corridor; take the unexplored downward branch and continue wall-following.
At (-3,1) after moving down. Down is blocked; explore the open left branch first while maintaining wall-following.
At (-4,1) after moving left. Both up and right are open; take the longer unexplored upward corridor.
At (-4,2) in a vertical corridor. Up continues three cells toward a junction; down returns. Continue upward exploration.
At (-4,3), the vertical corridor continues upward toward the junction seen ahead. Continue upward exploration; down only backtracks.
At (-4,4), continue upward to the junction ahead; left branch can be explored next while maintaining wall-following.
At (-4,5), upward and right are blocked. Take the open left branch to continue exploring the maze.
At (-5,4); after entering from the right, follow the left-hand rule by taking the open downward branch.
At (-5,3) after moving down. Up and left are open; take the unexplored left corridor while continuing wall-following.
At (-6,3), corridor continues left; right backtracks. Continue left to explore the unvisited path.
At the new leftmost junction, right backtracks through the mapped corridor. Explore the open downward branch.
At (-7,2) after moving down. Up returns toward the mapped corridor; take the open left branch to continue exploring.
At (-8,2) after moving left. Left is blocked; explore the open upward branch first and continue mapping.
At (-8,3) after moving up; the corridor continues upward one cell to a junction. Continue exploring upward.
At (-8,4); up and left are blocked. Take the open right corridor to explore the next branch.
At (-7,4) in a short horizontal corridor. Continue right to inspect the dead end, then backtrack if needed.
At the dead end reached by moving right. Backtrack left to the junction and continue the wall-following exploration.
At the corridor junction after backtracking from the dead end. Continue left toward the unvisited branch; the next cell offers a downward route.
At (-9,4), right backtracks through the corridor; take the unexplored downward branch.
Moved down into a vertical corridor. Continue downward along the unexplored route; upward is the return path.
Current position estimated by action tally. Left is blocked; continue down the unexplored corridor, preserving wall-following.
At (-8,1); down and left are blocked. The downward route is now exhausted, so take the open right branch to continue exploration.
At the new corridor cell after moving right. Continue right into the unexplored path; left backtracks toward the mapped area.
At the current corridor cell, right is blocked and left appears to backtrack. Take the open downward branch to explore new territory.
At the junction after moving down. Follow the open left corridor first; right remains an alternative branch if this route backtracks.
At the horizontal corridor after moving left. Inspect the short left dead-end, then backtrack toward the branching route if needed.
At a dead-end corridor cell with only the right exit open. Backtrack right toward the branching route.
At (-8,0) after backtracking. The right corridor leads to an unexplored junction; continue right.
At the junction after moving right. Continue right into the unexplored corridor; up and left remain alternatives for later backtracking.
At the new cell after moving right. Right and down are blocked; explore the open upward branch before backtracking left.
At (-5,1) in a vertical corridor. The cell above opens left and down, so move up to inspect the unvisited branch.
At (-5,2) after moving up. Up and right are blocked; take the open left branch to continue exploring.
At a dead end with only the right corridor open. Backtrack right to the previously explored junction and continue mapping.
Returned right from the dead end; take the open downward corridor, which appears to be the remaining unexplored route.
At (-4,1) in a vertical corridor after moving down. Continue downward to explore the remaining route; upward backtracks.
At (-5,0), both up and left are open. Explore the left corridor, which has three cells of line of sight and appears to be the remaining route.
At (-6,0); left and right corridors are mapped. Explore the open upward branch to avoid repeating the known loop.
At (-6,1) after moving up. Down backtracks; take the open left branch to continue exploring the remaining corridor.
At a horizontal corridor after moving left. Continue left to explore the remaining route; right backtracks.
At the new junction after moving left. Explore the open upward branch first; right can be used for backtracking or later exploration.
At the junction after moving up. Left is blocked; continue upward along the unexplored corridor while preserving wall-following.
At (-9,3) in a vertical corridor. Up reaches the next junction; down backtracks. Continue upward to explore.
At the junction after moving up. Up and left are blocked; down backtracks along the mapped corridor, so take the open right branch to continue exploring.
Right led into a dead-end corridor; backtrack left to the junction and follow the remaining downward route.
At the junction after backtracking from the right dead end. Take the open downward corridor, the remaining unexplored route.
Continue downward along the remaining corridor; the lower route is still unexplored.
Moved down into the open lower corridor. Continue downward to explore the remaining route; up is the mapped return path.
At the junction after moving down. Up backtracks through the mapped corridor; take the open right branch to continue exploring.
At the horizontal corridor after moving right. Continue right into the unexplored branch; left backtracks toward the mapped area.
At a corridor junction with down and left open. Take the downward branch to continue exploring rather than backtrack left.
At the junction after moving down. The left branch was previously explored toward a dead end; take the open right branch to continue searching for the exit.
At the current junction after moving right. Right and down are blocked; take the open upward corridor to continue exploring.
At (-5,1) in a vertical corridor. Continue upward toward the next junction; the downward route backtracks.
At (-5,2); up and right are blocked. Continue left through the open branch; down backtracks.
At a dead end with only the right corridor open. Backtrack right toward the mapped junction and continue exploring.
At the junction after backtracking right from the dead end. Down is the remaining unexplored corridor; left leads back toward the dead end.
Continue downward through the corridor; the adjacent cells offer left branches, so keep exploring this route before backtracking.
At the current cell after moving down. Both up and left are open; the left corridor extends three cells and is the best remaining exploration route.
At the junction after moving left; continue along the open left corridor to probe the remaining route.
Moved left into the corridor end; the left route appears to terminate, so inspect this branch before backtracking toward the junction.
At a dead end with only the right corridor open. Backtrack right toward the junction and continue exploring.
Backtracked from the dead end into the corridor. Continue right toward the junction and remaining unexplored branches.
At the junction after returning from the left dead-end corridor. The upward branch remains the best unexplored option; take it now.
At the cell reached after moving up. Up and right are blocked; continue left along the available corridor to probe remaining territory.
At a horizontal corridor after moving left. Continue left toward the junction; right backtracks along the mapped route.
At the junction, the upward corridor remains the best unexplored continuation; follow it while maintaining the relative position estimate.
At the three-way junction after moving up. The upward corridor has been repeatedly explored; take the right branch now to investigate the remaining route and avoid another loop.
At the right branch cell; upward is a mapped dead-end route, while left returns to the junction. Backtrack left to seek the remaining path.
At the junction after backtracking left. Right is a dead end; probe the downward branch before revisiting the upward corridor.
At the junction after moving down. Probe the open right corridor, which may lead to an unvisited branch; avoid immediately repeating the upward route.
At the horizontal corridor junction. Continue right along the available route and keep probing for an exit, updating position from the successful prior move.
At the current cell after moving right; up and right are blocked. Follow the open downward branch to continue wall-following exploration.
At the junction after moving down; down is blocked. The left route has repeatedly looped, so take the open right branch to seek an unvisited path.
Moved right successfully into a cell with up and left open. Take the upward corridor to continue exploring rather than repeat the left loop.
At a vertical corridor after moving up. The upward branch previously led to a dead end; backtrack downward toward the remaining junctions and continue systematic exploration.
Returned to the junction after checking the upward dead end. Take the open left corridor to continue systematic exploration.
At the junction, left appears to lead into a known dead-end corridor and right repeats a loop. Try the upward branch, which has not been directly explored from this cell.
At the cell reached by moving up; only down and left are open. Take the left corridor to continue systematic exploration.
Moved left into the horizontal corridor. Continue left toward the junction while tracking the remaining unexplored branches.
At the recurring junction after moving left. Continue upward along the longer corridor to systematically probe for the exit.
At the recurring three-way junction after moving up. The right branch has been checked and dead-ends; take the downward branch to systematically inspect the remaining route.
At the recurring junction after moving down. Explore the open right corridor again; it is the only route not immediately backtracking upward.
Moved right from the recurring junction into the horizontal corridor. Continue right to systematically probe the connected route for an exit.
At the corridor junction after moving right; down is the remaining unexplored branch, while left backtracks through the known loop.
At the junction after moving down; down is blocked. The left corridor has been explored repeatedly, so take the open right branch to search for an unvisited route.
At the current junction after moving right. Up and left are open; follow the upward corridor to continue systematic exploration and avoid the repeatedly traversed left loop.
At a vertical corridor with up and down open. Continue upward to inspect the branch ahead; downward backtracks.
At the cell reached by moving up; upward and right are blocked. Take the open left branch, with down reserved for backtracking.
At a dead end with only the right corridor open. Backtrack right toward the mapped junction and continue systematic exploration.
Backtracked from the dead end. Take the open downward corridor, which is the remaining route to investigate.
At the vertical corridor after moving down. Continue downward toward the remaining junction; upward backtracks through the mapped route.
Moved down successfully. At the current junction, both up and left are open; take the left corridor to continue exploring the remaining route.
Moved left into the current junction. The left corridor extends two cells and appears least explored; continue left before backtracking to inspect the remaining branches.
Moved left into the corridor. Continue left to inspect the remaining branch; right backtracks toward the junction.
At the corridor with one cell visible left, likely a dead end. Inspect it to complete exploration, then backtrack right if necessary.
Left is blocked at the corridor end; backtrack right toward the junction and continue exploring.
At the corridor end after the blocked left attempt. Only right is open, so backtrack toward the junction.
